column3: NASB follows the critical text; “left behind” is rendered “abandoned,” and “saw” is “suffer.” Part of the verse is in capitals.
NASB follows the critical text; “poured out” is rendered “poured forth.”
NASB adds “it was … who”; the quotation is in capitals.
NASB renders “place” as “make”; the NASB text here has “THINE” for “Your,” and its quotation marks are irregular.
NASB follows the critical text; “other” is rendered “the rest of.”
NASB follows the critical text; “he declared” is rendered “said.”
NASB follows the critical text; “was exhorting” is rendered “kept on exhorting.”
NASB follows the critical text without “gladly.”
NASB follows the critical text without “and”; “steadfastly continuing” is rendered “continually devoting themselves.”
NASB follows the critical text; “awe came upon every soul” is rendered “everyone kept feeling a sense of awe.”
NASB renders “at each house” as “from house to house” and adds “together.”
NASB follows the critical text; “to them” is rendered “to their number.”
